main_text.head: CONSEQUENTIA BONA Ex Calvini praedestinatione deducta.
main_text.p: Objectiones sunt: stante praedestinatione (à Calvino asserta) concidit omnis sollicitudo & benè agendi studium. Nam

I. Si immutabili Dei decreto uni-cuiquè fixa eft aut vita,aut mors,nihil intereft quomodo fe gerat, quia fuo opere nihil promoveri poteft Dei prædeftinatio. Et fic deploratum in morem, quocunquè libido tulerit, præcipites ibunt.
2. Scit Deus quid de nobis agere femel ftatuerit: fi falutem decrevit adducet nos ad eam fuo tempore, fi mortem deftinavit, fruftra contra tenderemus.
3. Securos fe in vitiis pergere dicunt, qui fi fint in numero electorum nihil

page.notes: Part 1 of 2; the text continues below and is not transcribed here. Running head is in small capitals. The ornamental rule above the heading is a printer's ornament, not transcribed. Spelling in the heading is as printed ("praedestinatione", "deducta" with ct ligature rendered as ct). The "s" long s rendered as s throughout. Nothing printed in the margins. The last line "nihil" is set flush right at the foot of the column, apparently a catchword.
